svg.aria-label: Architecture: a seeded workload generator writes transactions to Postgres 16; Debezium 3.0 on Kafka Connect publishes JSON change envelopes to Redpanda topics cdc.public.*, where the generator also injects replays and poison records. A Spark 3.5 Structured Streaming job (foreachBatch) writes Iceberg tables on MinIO: bronze.cdc_events, bronze.dead_letter and ops.stream_batches with an insert-only MERGE on topic, partition and offset, and the silver tables with a MERGE only where the incoming LSN is newer. Trino 476 and dbt-trino build the gold dimensions, fct_payments and the roll-rate mart. cdc verify reconciles Postgres against silver and bronze with row counts and checksums.

svg.text: From Postgres to the lake, and back to check
